findings.title: Evidence return loses comparison position
findings.statement: Returning from evidence resets the selected comparison facet and scroll anchor.

severity.rationale: Users reconstruct context during a critical verification journey.

confidence.basis: Direct browser exercise reproduced the loss.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Comparison state is not represented in navigation state.

recommendation.action: Preserve selected facet and scroll anchor across evidence return.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Return restores the selected facet and scroll anchor.

verification_method.procedure: Drill down, return, and assert facet plus anchor.

evidence.exact_observation: Browser Back restored default state instead of prior context.

flow_recommendation.intent: Verify a claim and return without reconstruction.
flow_recommendation.required_behavior: Return preserves selected facet and scroll anchor.
flow_recommendation.return_path: Browser Back restores the exact prior comparison state.
